content.text: I will create the workspace, copy the file, record metadata, build the line-offset index, verify coverage, and output the total line count. I'll run a short shell script to perform these steps and print the line count.

arguments:
{"script":"set -euo pipefail
workspace=temp_workspace
mkdir -p "$workspace"
cp -a /root/matrix.txt "$workspace/matrix_copy.txt"
filesize=$(stat -c%s "$workspace/matrix_copy.txt")
sha=$(sha256sum "$workspace/matrix_copy.txt" | awk '{print $1}')
printf "size:%s\nsha256:%s\n" "$filesize" "$sha" > "$workspace/matrix_copy.metadata"
# build line-offset index (byte offsets of start of each line)
awk 'BEGIN{offset=0} {print offset; offset+=length($0)+1}' "$workspace/matrix_copy.txt" > "$workspace/matrix_lines.idx"
# verify index covers whole file
last_offset=$(tail -n1 "$workspace/matrix_lines.idx")
last_line_len=$(tail -n1 "$workspace/matrix_copy.txt" | wc -c)
bytes_remaining=$((filesize - last_offset))
if [ "$bytes_remaining" -eq "$last_line_len" ] || [ "$bytes_remaining" -eq $((last_line_len+1)) ]; then ok=1; else ok=0; fi
lines=$(wc -l < "$workspace/matrix_lines.idx")
# output concise verification and line count for the next step
printf "VERIFIED:%s\n" "$ok"
printf "LINES:%s\n" "$lines"
"}
